phases.name: repo + secrets + auto-deploy
phases.notes: Repo private, secrets sealed-box encrypted (CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN, CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID), deploy.yml pushes site/ to Pages on every main push. Verified push triggered a deploy run.

phases.name: research + ingestion (copy ClipForge)
phases.notes: Ingestion ported from ClipForge stage_a: jobs/<id>/ingest-request.json -> workflow_dispatch -> aria2/requests/gdrive download -> release asset. 24h TTL via cleanup.yml.

phases.name: auth gate (PAT)
phases.notes: Pages _middleware.js validates x-castcut-pat against GitHub /user; only login==motionssalt passes. Token lives in browser localStorage only.

phases.name: mode 1: faces pipeline
phases.notes: hysts/anime-face-detector (YOLOv3, CPU) + deepghs CCIP embeddings (imgutils) + online centroid clustering (cos thr 0.35). Fallbacks: lbpcascade_animeface + HSV histograms. 1fps sampling, tunable.

phases.name: mode 1: gallery UI + export
phases.notes: Single manifest.json with embedded 112px WebP base64 thumbs; ordered tap-to-select, merge groups, ignore; export = ordered hard-cut concat + x264 CRF23 slow, before/after sizes logged.

phases.name: mode 2: scene pipeline
phases.notes: faster-whisper tiny transcript + ffmpeg scdet 0.35 scene index + 480p screenshots; agent prompt embeds strict JSON schema + scene request.

phases.name: mode 2: UI + JSON import + export
phases.notes: Paste JSON -> scene_export.py validates with numbered errors -> full-quality cut (CRF 14) hard-cut join -> one release file.

phases.name: polish, size checks, README
phases.notes: README covers setup, modes, JSON schema, resume protocol, TTL. All modules py_compile clean.

decisions: Face detector: hysts/anime-face-detector YOLOv3 (CPU) over RetinaFace/FasterRCNN — best accuracy-per-second on free runners; lbpcascade_animeface is fallback only.
Embeddings: deepghs CCIP via imgutils (512-d), cosine threshold 0.35; HSV histogram fallback if model download fails.
Clustering: online nearest-centroid, no sklearn dependency.
Sampling: 1 fps default (tunable 0.5-2), frames scaled to 480p; capped at 3600 frames for long videos.
Thumbnails: 112px WebP q78 base64 embedded in a single manifest.json so the gallery loads in one request.
Storage: GitHub release castcut-<job_id> per job; 24h TTL, hourly cleanup.yml deletes expired releases.
Mode 1 export: ordered per-character, no interleave, no duplicated ranges, hard cuts only, x264 CRF 23 slow final pass (sizes logged).
Mode 2 export: full quality (CRF 14), hard cuts, strict JSON schema v1 with numbered validation errors.
Auth: Pages middleware checks GitHub /user login==motionssalt on every /api/* call; PAT stays client-side.

size_and_audio.size_findings:
ffprobe on real export (castcut-export-exp-job-1791410158245-1kwa-scene-mveee92x.mp4, 146.35s, 123,456,765 bytes / 117.74 MB, 6.75 Mbps):
- Video (stream 0, h264 1080p): 6.55 Mbps, ~119.8 MB (97.1% of bytes). Root cause: scene_export.py hardcoded crf=14 preset=medium with zero compression pass.
- Audio: uncompressed/unmanaged multi-channel streams carried over.
- Solution: Single shared HandBrake-style anime encoding path in encode_final_export(): x264 CRF 23, preset medium, -tune animation, pix_fmt yuv420p, faststart, AAC 128k stereo downmix, dropping subtitles, data, chapters (-sn -dn -map_chapters -1).
- Real run measurement (Run 39216746366, 146.35s 1080p anime): reduced from 123.46 MB (6.75 Mbps) to 29.30 MB (1.60 Mbps) -> 76.3% file size reduction with visual losslessness preserved.
size_and_audio.audio_findings:
ffprobe on real source (source.mkv in job-1791410158245-1kwa):
- 16 streams total: stream 0 video (av1), stream 1 audio (opus 5.1, Japanese, default), stream 2 audio (opus stereo, Japanese), stream 3 audio (opus stereo, English), streams 4-6 subtitles (ass), streams 7-15 font attachments.
- Root causes: pipeline hardcoded -map 0:a:0? in concat_segments, completely ignoring tracks 1 and 2 (Japanese stereo and English stereo). No track picker existed in UI.
- Solution: probe_audio_tracks() detects all audio streams with language tags (mapped to human names), channel layout, codec, title, and default flag. Audio track picker in UI (both Faces and AI Scene flows) preselects remembered choice or default track. Explicit mapping: -map 0:v:0 -map 0:a:<chosen>. Output strictly validated by ffprobe to guarantee exactly 1 video stream and exactly 1 AAC audio stream (0 subtitles, 0 attachments).

Performance & Lag Investigation (Mobile Android / Network analysis):
1. Monolithic payload: Single app.js (56.6 KB) + index.html (13.1 KB) + styles.css (19.0 KB) = 88.7 KB initial load.
2. Single DOM for all screens: All 7 views (Gate, Home, New Project, Torrent selection, Overview, Clips/Gallery, Scene/AI, Exports, Task card) lived in one heavy DOM.
3. Global timer polling: setInterval polled /api/jobs/:id every 4s continuously even when user was on home or idle.
4. Tapping lag: Tapping cards caused unresponsive waiting because all subviews were bound in one giant script.
Results after multi-page split:
- First-load HTML reduced from 13.1 KB to 2.1 KB.
- First-load JS reduced from 56.6 KB to 5.1 KB (home.js) + common.js (16 KB, browser-cached across all pages).
- Real separate pages with clean URLs: / (home), /new/, /project/?id=..., /faces/?id=..., /scene/?id=..., /exports/?id=..., /task/?id=...
- Instant navigation response: light loading skeleton on tap, prefetching of likely next tabs on hover/touch.
- Scoped polling: polling only occurs while a job is in an active running state on that specific page, stopped immediately upon navigating away.
- PAT gate preserved seamlessly: remembered in localStorage, zero content flashing on load.

api_contract.auth: Header x-castcut-pat: <github_pat>, verified against GitHub user motionssalt

endpoints.GET /api/jobs: Returns { jobs: [...] } with reconciled action statuses
endpoints.POST /api/jobs: Creates new job, accepts { title, content_type, source: { kind, url?, magnet?, torrent_b64? }, torrent_name?, files?, selected_indices? }
endpoints.GET /api/jobs/:id: Returns complete project state, status, ingest info, clipsManifest, files, selection, sceneAgent, audioChoice, exports, releases, runs
endpoints.DELETE /api/jobs/:id: Cancels active runs, deletes project releases and tags, deletes committed files in jobs/:id/
endpoints.POST /api/jobs/:id/cancel: Cancels active GitHub Action workflow runs for the job
endpoints.POST /api/jobs/:id/retry: Intelligently identifies and retriggers the last failed/cancelled workflow
endpoints.POST /api/jobs/:id/repair: Triggers face, scene, or hybrid analysis workflow re-run
endpoints.PUT /api/jobs/:id/selection: Confirms torrent file indices and dispatches ingest.yml
endpoints.DELETE /api/jobs/:id/selection: Clears selection and resets job to awaiting_selection
endpoints.POST /api/jobs/:id/audio-choice: Saves selected audio track index to jobs/:id/audio_choice.json
endpoints.DELETE /api/jobs/:id/exports/:exportId: Deletes finished export json and release asset record

api_contract.storage: GitHub repository committed files at jobs/<id>/ and GitHub releases at castcut-<id>
